prompt: A small orange cat with a white chest wakes up on a sunny windowsill, stretches, jumps down to the kitchen floor and drinks from a blue bowl.
An old fisherman in a yellow raincoat rows a wooden boat out at dawn, casts a net over the side and pulls up a silver fish, smiling.
A girl with a red backpack runs to catch a city bus, waves at the driver and sits down by the window as the bus pulls away.
A brown bear cub climbs onto a fallen log in a pine forest, slips into a shallow stream and shakes the water off on the bank.
A chef in a white uniform chops green onions, tosses noodles in a smoking wok and sets a steaming bowl on the counter.
A red diamond-shaped kite rises above a grassy hill, loops in the wind and gets caught in the branches of a lone oak tree.
An astronaut in a white suit with a blue stripe steps down from a lander onto grey dust, plants a small flag and looks up at the Earth.
A golden retriever chases a tennis ball across a beach, splashes into the waves and carries the ball back to its owner.
A boy in a green hoodie rolls a big snowball, puts a carrot nose on his finished snowman and is hit by a snowball from behind.
A hummingbird with an emerald back hovers beside a red flower, drinks its nectar and darts away across the garden.
A woman in a long black coat opens her umbrella as rain starts, crosses a busy street and steps into a warmly lit cafe.
A small wooden sailboat with a white sail leaves a harbor, sails through choppy water and drops anchor in a quiet bay at sunset.
A robot with a round head and orange paint waters plants in a greenhouse, notices a drooping flower and gently ties it to a stick.
A grey elephant calf follows its mother to a watering hole, sprays water over its back with its trunk and rolls in the mud.
A teenage skateboarder in a purple helmet rolls down a ramp, jumps over a curb and lands, raising both arms.
A black steam locomotive puffs out of a mountain tunnel, crosses a stone bridge and stops at a small station.
A baker in a flour-dusted apron kneads dough, slides loaves into a brick oven and pulls out golden bread.
A bright green frog sits on a lily pad, catches a fly with its tongue and leaps into the pond.
A man in a blue suit misses a closing elevator, runs up a staircase and arrives out of breath at a meeting room.
A child folds a sheet of white paper into a paper airplane, throws it out of a classroom window and it lands on the playground.
A white swan glides across a misty lake, spreads its wings and takes off over the trees.
A little girl in a yellow dress plants a seed in a clay pot, waters it and finds a green sprout the next morning.
A knight in silver armor rides a black horse up to a castle gate, dismounts and knocks on the wooden door.
A red fox creeps through snowy grass, pounces into the snow and trots away with a mouse in its mouth.
A guitarist with long curly hair tunes an acoustic guitar on a wooden porch, starts to play, and a dog lies down at his feet.
A hot air balloon with rainbow stripes is inflated in a field at dawn, lifts off and floats over a river valley.
A penguin waddles to the edge of an ice floe, dives into the sea and swims past a school of fish.
A painter in a paint-splattered shirt sketches on a canvas, mixes blue paint on a palette and brushes a sky onto the picture.
A small yellow submarine dives under the waves, shines its lights on a coral reef and surfaces beside a ship.
A grandmother with silver hair knits a red scarf in an armchair, wraps it around her grandson's neck and they hug.
A monarch butterfly crawls out of its chrysalis, dries its orange wings on a twig and flutters away over a meadow.
A cyclist in a red jersey climbs a steep mountain road, reaches the top and coasts down past pine trees.
